title: C# Missing Texture Storage Bit with MSAA in Compositor Effect
body:
### Tested versions

- Tested in 4.4 .Net, didn't test earlier versions 



### System information

Windows 10, Godot 4.4 .Net

### Issue description

Creating a uniform set with the color buffer Rid in the compositor effect fails with an error message that the image has no TEXTURE_STORAGE_BIT set and than because of that another error message that the uniform is not set.

In the MRP it's through UniformSetCacheRD but it also fails through RenderingDevice.UniformSetCreate

### Steps to reproduce

- Add a c# compositor effect which uses a color buffer id in an image uniform and then change the MSAA settings to something else than disabled, it will now not work and will throw errors.

- MRP contains PostProcessGrayscaleCS which will fail, the GD counterpart post_process_grayscale will work with any MSAA setting. Both are added in the main scene's environment


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

I've ported the [compositor effect](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/rendering/compositor.html) from the official godot docs

Switching MSAA will break the PostProcessGrayscaleCS effect and cause error messages, GD version post_process_grayscale runs fine with any setting.

[https://github.com/Rokojori/godot-compositor-effect-c-sharp](https://github.com/Rokojori/godot-compositor-effect-c-sharp)
